meta.purpose: Controlled register for content that is required for the V2 website but is not yet supported by approved source material.
meta.rule: A placeholder may identify a missing item, but no name, number, credential, client endorsement or corporate claim may be invented.

items.item: Confirm the full director and senior leadership roster, names, reporting titles, 80–120 word bios, credentials and approved portraits for every director, CFO, CHRO, COO, Chief Commercial Officer, Chief Engineering & Digital Officer, Head of Quality & Commissioning, Head of HSE, Head of Procurement & Supply Chain and Company Secretary & Compliance Officer.
Provide the approved portrait and final profile review for Rajiv Aggarwal.
Obtain independent, current market evidence and Legal approval before publishing any 'India's largest' or '#1 MEPF firm' claim. Until then, lead with verified scale facts.
Reconcile and approve current workforce, engineer, manager, QA/QC, HSE, commissioning and design-team headcounts with an as-of date.
Resolve the missing_fields listed against the 39 incomplete landmark-project records, including client, value, dates, location, scope and approved narrative where absent.
Add approved workbook records for Amity Hyderabad, Bhondsi Factory Solar and Vinta Realty; resolve the Sky Mansion value discrepancy.
Add measurable case-study outcomes: programme milestones, safety performance, commissioning results, energy or reliability outcomes and client-approved handover evidence.
Decide which controlled method statements may be released externally, in what format, and under which approval or confidentiality workflow. The public V2 currently exposes only the index.
Attach approved certificate images or verification links, issuer, certificate number, scope and validity dates for each certification and empanelment.
Provide approved HSE performance metrics with reporting period and calculation basis, such as safe work-hours, LTIFR, training hours and audit closure rate.
Obtain written client approval for the two attributed testimonials, confirm full names and current titles, and retain the approval record before final publication.
Replace the three employee-story placeholders with real employees, roles, locations, approved portraits and approved quotations.
Confirm current logo artwork and publication permission for every displayed client; add missing high-resolution vector logos.
Provide approved sustainability policy, carbon and resource metrics, waste controls, green-building outcomes and reporting period before creating a substantive ESG page.

Reconcile current order book, FY25 turnover, net worth, banking lines, credit rating and single-project capacity. Keep these off the public marketing site until Finance approves the values and as-of dates.
Validate the status, dates and scope of work in Bangladesh, Nepal and Maldives before presenting them as an active operating footprint.
Provide Legal-approved privacy notice, terms of use, cookie position and grievance/contact details; replace the current non-linked footer labels.
Replace the mail-client-only form with an approved enquiry endpoint or CRM route, consent text, spam protection, routing owners and response-time SLA.
Collect verifiable awards, professional memberships, press coverage and publication dates before adding a recognition section.

Validate current headcount by function—engineering/design, BIM, planning, procurement, site execution, quality, HSE, commissioning, commercial and corporate services—with one agreed as-of date and employment basis.
Confirm direct workforce, project-site workforce, approved specialist-partner count, language coverage, regional distribution, competency controls and the exact direct/partner employment basis.
Replace eight grey photography slots with authentic, approved office, site, learning, testing, celebration and community photographs, each with caption and consent confirmation.
Validate current versus pilot AI use cases, approved platforms, data-governance policy, accountable owners and at least one measured delivery outcome before changing any status to 'in use'.

Prepare the controlled M&A/client diligence pack: audited financials, current order book, customer concentration, management depth, statutory registrations, claims/litigation, HSE/quality evidence, working capital and integration systems map.
